layerSpikes.meaning: Inspection heuristic, not an automatic physical-failure certificate.

limitations: Commanded ideal time omits acceleration, queue throughput, heating, homing and opaque macro internals. It includes literal dwell and E-only moves.
XY/Z bounds audit only visible literal commands, not firmware macros. Mass uses assumed 1.26 g/cm3 and commanded 1.75 mm filament.
